central.observeOnly: Observe only: saving enables collection and rule evaluation. No torrents are added or removed. Existing downloader rules keep their current behavior.
central.emptyRules: Add sources, then create a reception rule.
central.addSiteFirst: Add a site below before creating a source.
central.loadError: Could not load the configuration or observations. Please retry.
central.saveError: Could not save. Check the fields and referenced sources or targets, then retry.
central.deleteHelp: Deletion cannot be undone. A source also loses its observation records. Referenced entries must be removed from rules first.
central.deleteError: Could not delete. Remove references first, then retry.
central.name: Name
central.baseHelp: Use the site origin, without a private path or query.
central.secretHelp: Leave blank to keep the saved secret. Enter a new value to replace it.
central.hostsHelp: One hostname per line, without an announce path or passkey.
central.requestHelp: Sources for this origin share this request budget. Slow responses do not block unrelated sources.
central.urlHelp: The full address is stored encrypted and is not returned in configuration responses.
central.lookbackHelp: Used only when the source first establishes its baseline. Editing or restarting does not reset it. This is separate from a rule’s reception window.
central.adapterUnavailable: A supported site format is required. Retry loading the capabilities.
central.adapterValidation: Formats have synthetic fixture coverage; compatibility with live sites still needs verification.
central.fetchError: Source request failed; retry is scheduled.
central.acceptHelp: Selected types use OR. Keywords, size and time conditions all use AND. Confirmed official releases keep the highest priority.
central.chooseKind: Select at least one reception type.
central.revivalUnavailable: No selected source is enabled and supports revival detection. Check the source, its site and adapter capabilities.
central.targetHelp: Choose one downloader or one reusable group. A winning rule with an unavailable target does not fall back to another rule.
central.targetUnavailable: This group is disabled or has no members. Matching candidates will wait.
central.windowHelp: Measured from the source event time. Set this explicitly for the rule; later sources do not restart it.
central.includeHelp: One keyword per line. All must occur in the title; matching ignores letter case.
central.excludeHelp: One keyword per line. Any match rejects the title.
central.reclaim: Allow space recovery for official releases
central.reclaimHelp: Permission only. Recovery conditions and budgets belong to downloaders and are not active in this observation stage.
central.previewHelp: Saved rules are evaluated in the background. Results refresh every five seconds. Ready means the rule matched, not that a download was added.
central.migrationHelp: Preview only. Nothing is imported, enabled or disabled. Unsupported settings must be resolved before handoff; existing automatic download rules are unchanged.
central.vertexHelp: Choose an individual RSS task, RSS rule or web monitor file, or a bundle with rss, rules and webMonitors arrays. Files up to 2 MiB are read locally in this browser; URL secrets and Cookies are masked.
central.invalidExport: The file is invalid, unsupported or larger than 2 MiB. Choose a supported Vertex configuration JSON.

execution.title: Downloader reception
execution.setupHelp: Enable reception per downloader after mapping its storage paths and configuring the site’s Tracker hosts. Missing or stale capacity keeps candidates waiting.
execution.enabledIntro: Reception is enabled on selected downloaders. Matching rules can add torrents; submitted requests are reconciled on their original target.
execution.disabledIntro: Reception is disabled. Sources and rules can be configured and previewed without adding torrents.
execution.configurationHelp: Changes affect future decisions on downloaders with reception enabled. Submitted requests keep their original target and rule.
execution.noInstances: Add a downloader before configuring reception.
execution.enableLabel: Allow matching rules to add torrents to this downloader
execution.enableWarning: Saving with reception enabled allows automatic adding. Stop overlapping automatic adding in qBittorrent or Vertex before enabling. Disabling stops new submissions; requests already sent remain under observation.
execution.reclaimEnableLabel: Enable official-candidate reclamation on this downloader
execution.reclaimEnableWarning: This can permanently delete low-efficiency torrents and their files to make room for an official candidate. Enable only after disabling competing automatic deletion in other applications. Existing unknown operations remain blocked when this is turned off.
execution.maxConcurrentAddsHelp: Maximum outstanding additions on this downloader. A slow downloader does not block other downloaders.
execution.maxActiveDownloadsHelp: Incomplete torrents and unresolved additions occupy slots, including paused and queued torrents.
execution.minFreeBytesHelp: Leave this much space after accounting for existing future writes and new reservations on every required disk.
execution.savePathHelp: Leave empty to use the current default path. Every final and temporary path must have a storage-pool mapping.
execution.historyHelp: Request acceptance, task confirmation, runnable state and first transfer are separate stages. Unknown requests keep their target and disk reservation and are never blindly resent.

reasons.reevaluation_required: Configuration or evidence changed; reevaluation is required.
reasons.target_unavailable: Waiting for a fresh, healthy target observation.
reasons.tracker_identity_unverified: The site and account Tracker has not been confirmed.
reasons.existing_tracker_mismatch: This hash already exists with a different or unverified Tracker. No add request was sent.
reasons.awaiting_task: Waiting for the original downloader to report this task.
reasons.task_removed: The previously confirmed task remained absent in fresh observations; its reservation was released.

analysis.help: Read-only sampling for 20 minutes after confirmed reception. Stores IP addresses and BT ports for 30 days. Does not enable reception or deletion.
analysis.empty: No samples recorded. Sampling may be disabled or history may have expired.
analysis.unknown: Site rankings remain unavailable. Connected peers and completion times do not prove the original uploader.
analysis.absent: Absent from the last complete sample
analysis.truncated: History reached its endpoint limit or a sample was incomplete; coverage includes this gap.
